text:
제 얘기라 제가 하기가
조금 *민망*스럽긴 한데
en: It's a bit awkward, since it's about me.

text:
제가 예전에 대구에서
열심히 *신앙 훈련*을 하고
en: I used to train hard in my faith in Daegu,

text:
저희 리더가 서울로
장신대로 입학하는 바람에
en: but my leader left for seminary in Seoul,
and no one was left to train me.
So I went to church in Seoul, all the way from Daegu,
riding home at dawn every Monday, for two years.
In the newcomers' class,
every week we handed in a report
on the sermon and the class.
They gave us one sheet like this

text:
이 박스 안에
그거를 써서 제출하는 거예요
en: to fill in the box and hand in.

text:
제가 매주 다섯 여섯 장을
제출했던 것 같아요
en: I think I handed in five or six pages a week.
I had one thought.

text:
학교에 리포트 제출할 때
내가 그렇게 안 하거든요
en: You'd never hand in a school report like that.
You add a cover page,
make the cover look nice,
print it out neatly,
and then hand it in.
So training in faith before God,
I didn't want to give less than a school report.
Every week I turned in quality work.
Our newcomers' class minister told me,

text:
저보고 "형제, 내가
새가족반 정말 오래 했는데
en: "Brother, I've led this class a long time,

text:
준 것만큼 안 쓰고
*더해서* 낸 사람은
en: but people who wrote more than the sheet we gave?

text:
자기 평생에 딱
*두 사람*밖에 못 봤다"
en: I've seen only two in my whole life."
There's Oswald Chambers's famous book,

text:
정말 유명한 책입니다
원래 제목이 뭐죠?
en: and what's its original title?
My utmost for His highest: that's what I want to give.
That's the summit of faith.

text:
*사랑*은 사랑하는 사람의 소원이
그들에게 명령이 되듯이
en: Love makes the wishes of the one you love your commands;
living like that is what normal faith looks like.
